turns.content: Thanks for calling Cloud Aurum! This is Amy, the AI front desk — I help with questions and scheduling. What can I do for you?
Hi, I run a two-location dental group and we keep missing calls after hours.
That's the exact friction Cloud Aurum works on. Missed calls after hours are usually the biggest leak. Can I email you the link to book time with Mark?
Sent. You'll see it in a minute or two.
